item.title: PHOTOS: Medway vs. St. Thomas Aquinas, AAA girls high school hockey final
item.description: Medway defeated St. Thomas Aquinas at Nichols arena in London on Tuesday to win the TVRA girls AAA high school hockey championship. Both teams are now set to go to WOSSAA, scheduled for next week in Stratford. Photos by LFP’s Mike Hensen mhensen@postmedia.com @MikeatLFPress
